candidates.title: Cross-domain action primitives
candidates.oneSentence: Real-world action must begin from independently addressable, fact-bound direction, perspective, and authority, and return as independently replayable causal experience.
candidates.claimBoundary: This candidate is preserved as the source lineage promoted into active KFD-7. KFD-7 does not turn Fact or Episode into ordinary domain-Primitives, require named physical stores, claim literal physical spacetime or Euclidean dimensionality, or establish universal necessity. Its Atlas, Pursuit, and Warrant elaborations were later promoted into numbered drafts KFD-8, KFD-9, and KFD-10.

candidates.title: Atlas action perspective
candidates.oneSentence: Every consequential action must bind to an addressable perspective and fact cut.
candidates.claimBoundary: This candidate is preserved as source lineage promoted into numbered draft KFD-8. KFD-8 allocates Atlas as the canonical perspective coordinate but does not mandate one serialization or product surface, claim perspective completeness, establish active status, or prove universal necessity.

candidates.title: Pursuit intent continuity
candidates.oneSentence: Intent that survives an action must have an identity independent of the action that advances it.
candidates.claimBoundary: This candidate is preserved as source lineage promoted into numbered draft KFD-9. KFD-9 allocates Pursuit as the canonical direction coordinate but does not mandate one decomposition shape or workflow, establish active status, or prove universal necessity.

candidates.title: Warrant bounded authority
candidates.oneSentence: Permission to act must remain explicit, bounded, derivable, and independently revocable.
candidates.claimBoundary: This candidate is preserved as source lineage promoted into numbered draft KFD-10. KFD-10 allocates Warrant as the canonical authority coordinate but does not replace domain authorization systems, mandate one token or approval shape, establish active status, or prove universal necessity.
